```artifact
Decision Table for Alarm and Safety Actions

Conditions:
- blower_motor_temp: temperature of blower motor (°C)
- blower_power_temp: temperature of blower power management system (°C)
- battery_temp: temperature of battery cell (°C)
- blower_motor_threshold: user-specified threshold for blower motor temperature (°C)
- blower_power_threshold: user-specified threshold for blower power system temperature (°C)
- battery_threshold: user-specified threshold for battery temperature (°C)

Actions:
- alarm_blower_motor: trigger "blower motor temperature too high" alarm
- alarm_blower_power: trigger "blower power system temperature too high" alarm
- alarm_battery: trigger "battery temperature too high" alarm
- safety_action_blower_power: invoke safety action for blower power system
- safety_action_battery: invoke safety action for battery

Decision Table:

| blower_motor_temp | blower_power_temp | battery_temp | blower_motor_threshold | blower_power_threshold | battery_threshold | alarm_blower_motor | alarm_blower_power | alarm_battery | safety_action_blower_power | safety_action_battery |
|-------------------|-------------------|--------------|------------------------|------------------------|-------------------|--------------------|--------------------|---------------|----------------------------|-----------------------|
| >= blower_motor_threshold | >= blower_power_threshold | >= battery_threshold | >= blower_motor_threshold | >= blower_power_threshold | >= battery_threshold | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| < blower_motor_threshold | < blower_power_threshold | < battery_threshold | >= blower_motor_threshold | >= blower_power_threshold | >= battery_threshold | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| >= blower_motor_threshold | < blower_power_threshold | < battery_threshold | >= blower_motor_threshold | >= blower_power_threshold | < battery_threshold | Yes | No | No | Yes | No |
| < blower_motor_threshold | >= blower_power_threshold | < battery_threshold | < blower_motor_threshold | >= blower_power_threshold | < battery_threshold | No | Yes | No | Yes | No |
| < blower_motor_threshold | < blower_power_threshold | >= battery_threshold | < blower_motor_threshold | < blower_power_threshold | >= battery_threshold | No | No | Yes | No | Yes |
| >= blower_motor_threshold | >= blower_power_threshold | < battery_threshold | >= blower_motor_threshold | >= blower_power_threshold | < battery_threshold | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | No |
| < blower_motor_threshold | >= blower_power_threshold | >= battery_threshold | < blower_motor_threshold | >= blower_power_threshold | >= battery_threshold | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| >= blower_motor_threshold | < blower_power_threshold | >= battery_threshold | >= blower_motor_threshold | < blower_power_threshold | >= battery_threshold | Yes | No | Yes | No | Yes |

Note: "-" indicates "don't care" or unspecified condition, which has no impact on the outcome.
```
